BasalTemperature.6: Nzira iri nyore yokusimbisa, pashure pokuitika, kuti ovulation yakaitika.
BasalTemperature.9: Nguva yokuyera uye nzira yokuyera nayo
BasalTemperature.15: Temperature yemuviri wepasi ndiyo tembiricha yemuviri wako uri pakurara zvakakwana, usati waita chero basa. Inosiyana zvishoma zvikuru mukati mehurongwa, pasi pesimba remahomoni ako.
BasalTemperature.16: Inoyera mangwanani oga oga, usati wamuka, nguva dzose panguva imwe chete uye nethermometer imwe chete.
BasalTemperature.18: Nguva dzose shandisa thermometer imwe chete, zvakanakisisa yebasa (zvakajeka, kusvika pa10°C).
BasalTemperature.20: Kuyera panguva yakatarwa, usati wamuka, mushure maawa matatu ekurara asina kuvhiringidzwa.
BasalTemperature.22: Nyora zvaunenge waverenga pakarepo, usati wamuka kana kuti wataura.
BasalTemperature.23: Temperature yemuviri yepasi inowedzera zvishoma (0. 2 kusvika 0.5 °C) mushure mokunge ovulation yapera, pasi pemigumisiro yeprogesterone, uye inoramba yakakwirira kusvikira nguva yako inotevera.
BasalTemperature.25: Pasi mukutanga kwechikamu chemutambo, inowedzera mushure mekubuda kwezvibereko uye inoramba iripo  ⁇  chimiro chinongojeka mushure memazuva akati wandei ekuverenga.

BasalTemperature.31: Iyi haisi nzira yekufanotaura asi yekusimbisa: inokubatsira kunzwisisa zviri nani kutenderera kwako, kana ovulation yatovepo  ⁇  kwete kuitarisira.
BasalTemperature.32: Kuzviona zvoga mumutambo mumwe kana miviri kazhinji hakukwani: muenzaniso unobuda nokudzokorora.
BasalTemperature.34: Hapana kukwira kwepfungwa kunooneka mumatanho akawanda akazara
BasalTemperature.35: Kunyangwe paine kuyerwa kwakanyatsonaka, tembiricha inoramba iripo
BasalTemperature.36: Une mibvunzo pamusoro pokubereka kwako iyo iyi chete kutevera haigoni kupindura
BasalTemperature.38: Kubatanidza tembiricha yemuviri yepasi pamwe chete nekucherechedza mucus wako wemuviri kana kuti ovulation test kunopa mufananidzo wakazara wemwedzi wako.
BasalTemperature.39: Basal body temperature inowedzera zvishoma (0. 2 kusvika 0.5°C) mushure mokunge ovulation yapera, pasi pemigumisiro yeprogesterone.
BasalTemperature.40: ⁇ Inoyera mangwanani oga oga, usati wamuka, nguva dzose panguva imwe chete uye nethermometer imwe chete.
BasalTemperature.41: Iyi haisi nzira yokufanotaura asi inosimbisa: inokubatsira kunzwisisa zviri nani kutenderera kwako.
BasalTemperature.42: Kuibatanidza nezvimwe zviratidzo (mucus womumutsi wemukadzi, kuongororwa kwe ovulation) kunopa mufananidzo wakazara.
BasalTemperature.43: Mashoko ari munyaya ino haatsivi mazano ekurapa anopiwa nemunhu mumwe nomumwe.

BirthControlPills.6: Mashandiro anoita piritsi racho, kuti rinotorwa sei zuva nezuva, uye zvakanakira uye zvinorambidzwa naro.
BirthControlPills.12: Pill ine mahormone  ⁇  estrogen uye/kana progestin, zvichienderana nerudzi  ⁇  izvo zvinoshanda zvikurukuru nekudzivirira kana kuvharira ovulation.
BirthControlPills.14: Kune marudzi akati wandei emapiritsi, kusanganisira mapiritsi akabatanidzwa uye mapiritsi ane progestin chete.
BirthControlPills.15: Kutora nguva dzose kunokosha. Zvichienderana nerudzi rwepiritsi, zvaunofanira kuita mushure mekurasikirwa nemushonga zvinogona kusiyana  ⁇  saka zvakakosha kuti uongorore mushonga wako  ⁇ pakeji.
BirthControlPills.16: Sarudza nguva yezuva iri nyore kuyeuka (zvokudya, nguva yokurara...)
BirthControlPills.17: Shandisa chiyeuchidzo kana kuti app kana zvichidiwa
BirthControlPills.18: Chengeta chinyorwa chepakiti kana paine mubvunzo
BirthControlPills.19: Kufanana nedzimwe nzira dzokuzvidzivirira nadzo, piritsi rine zvakanakira asiwo zvimwe zvaunofanira kuziva risati rasarudzwa.
BirthControlPills.22: Inoderedza zvikuru ngozi yokusununguka kana ikashandiswa nemazvo
BirthControlPills.23: Zvinogona kuita kuti nguva dzigare dzichifamba uye dzifanotaurwa
BirthControlPills.24: Kunogona kuderedza marwadzo uye kubuda ropa kune vamwe vanhu
BirthControlPills.25: Inogona kugadziriswa kana kuchinjwa kana isingakukodzereri
BirthControlPills.28: Inoda kugara ichitora zvichienderana nerudzi rwepiritsi
BirthControlPills.29: Kutapudzwa kwemishonga kunogona kuderedza kushanda kwayo
BirthControlPills.33: Pill inzira inoshanda yokudzivirira pamuviri yehomoni kana yakashandiswa nenzira yakarurama.
BirthControlPills.34: Kana uri kufunga nezvekudzivirira pamuviri kana kuti nzira yako yauri kushandisa haisi kukubatsira, usazeza kutaura nachiremba, mubereki kana kuti mumwewo munhu anoita basa rezveutano.

BoneHealth.6: Nei nguva yekusununguka ichiwedzera ngozi yokuva nemapfupa, uye kuti ungazvidzivirira sei mazuva ose.
BoneHealth.14: Estrogen inoita kuti mapfupa ave akawandisa uye inoderedza kutenderera kwemapfupa. Kuderera kweestrogen panguva yekare kunowedzera kurasikirwa nemapfupa, kunyanya mumakore mashomanana okutanga pashure pokunge nguva dzako dzapera.
BoneHealth.15: Osteopenia inoreva kuti mapfupa ane density yakaderera pane yakajairwa, pasina kusvika pamuganhu we osteoporosis. Osteoporosis is fragility bone yakanyanya kuoneka iyo inowedzera ngozi yekuputsika, kunyanya kana munhu akadonha.
BoneHealth.17: Mashoko ose ari maviri anoratidza kurasikirwa kwepfupa, kwete kuputsika kwakatoitika  ⁇  ivo  ⁇ vanokurudzira kudzivirira, kwete chikonzero chokunetseka.
BoneHealth.18: Kuongorora uku kusina kurwadza kunoyera kuwanda kwemaminerari emapfupa.
BoneHealth.26: Kuita basa rakaonda kana kuti kuita basa rakaderera
BoneHealth.28: Kuva nechimwe kana zvimwe zvezvinhu izvi hazvirevi kuti uchava ne osteoporosis  ⁇  ivo varipo zvikurukuru kuti vabatsire kutungamirira hurukuro nachiremba wako pamusoro pekutsvakurudza kunogona kuitika.
BoneHealth.30: Calcium, vhitamini D, uye kuita basa rinorema zvichiri tsika dzinobatsira zvikuru zuva nezuva kuti mapfupa asimbe kwenguva refu.

Breastfeeding.7: Mazuva okutanga okuyamwisa ndiwo nguva yokudzidza nokuda kwomwana nomudzimai. Kuvhara, kurira, nzvimbo, uye kuongorora zvishoma nezvishoma kunokubatsira kuwana zvaunonzwa wakasununguka.
Breastfeeding.16: Kuyamwisa kunotanga zvishoma nezvishoma. Maawa okutanga, uyezve mazuva okutanga, ipa mwana namai nguva yokudzidza pamwe chete.
Breastfeeding.20: Kuonana kweganda neganda uye kuvharirwa kwekutanga kunogona kubatsira kuti kuyamwisa kutange zvakanaka.
Breastfeeding.24: Kuyamwa kunozova tsika inowirirana pakati pomwana nomudzimai.
Breastfeeding.26: Mukaka unopiwa mwana wacho unochinja zvishoma nezvishoma kuti awane zvaanoda.
Breastfeeding.28: Panzvimbo pokuisa pfungwa pawachi chete, zvinogona kubatsira kuona zviratidzo zvomwana zvokumuka, zvokudya, uye mapundu.
Breastfeeding.30: Mwana achangoberekwa anogona kukumbira zvokudya kakawanda, dzimwe nguva ka8 kusvika ka12 mumaawa 24.
Breastfeeding.32: Mwana anogona kufamba, kuvhura muromo wake, kana kuti kutsvaka mudzi paanenge ava kunzwa nzara.
Breastfeeding.34: Nhamba yemadhayi anogeza uye akaora ndeimwe yezvinhu zvokucherechedza zuva nezuva.
Breastfeeding.36: Kana kurwadziwa kuchikura kana kuti kuchiramba kuchiitika, nyanzvi yezvokurapa inogona kuongorora nzvimbo uye kurova.
Breastfeeding.42: Mwana anochengetwa pedyo nomuviri, musoro wake uchigadzirirwa zvakanaka.
Breastfeeding.44: Mirira kuti muromo wako uvhurike zvakakwana usati waisa chifuva.
Breastfeeding.46: Kunamatira kunoshanda hakufaniri kukonzera marwadzo anokosha kana kuti anopfuurira.
Breastfeeding.48: Kuyamwa uye kumedza zvinofamba panguva yekudya.
Breastfeeding.50: Hapana chikonzero chokumirira kusvikira matambudziko ava akakomba. Nyanzvi yakadzidziswa inogona kubatsira kuongorora nzvimbo, chivhariso, kana kuti zvinodiwa nemwana.
Breastfeeding.56: Kunogona kubatsira kana kuvhara kwava kunetsa.
Breastfeeding.58: Mazuva okutanga anogona kusiyana zvikuru. Kufamba kwenguva kunogona kuchinja nguva yokudya uye uwandu hwemukaka. Kana paine chinhu chinokunetsa, bvunza nyanzvi yezvokurapa kuti ikupe zano.
Breastfeeding.60: Kudya kwekutanga nguva yokudzidza kwemwana nomudzimai.
Breastfeeding.62: Nzvimbo yakasununguka uye chinhu chakanaka chechichivhariso.
Breastfeeding.63: Kuona zviratidzo zvevana kunobatsira zvikuru kupfuura kuva nechirongwa chakanyatsogadziriswa.
Breastfeeding.64: Mubereki kana kuti chiremba anoona nezvekuyamwisa anogona kukubatsira kukunda matambudziko okutanga.
Breastfeeding.65: Nyaya ino haitsivi mazano anopiwa nemumwe munhu.

CervicalMucus.6: Chinhu chemuviri, chisina mhosva chokuona hwindo rako rakaorera.
CervicalMucus.21: Rakajeka, rinotambanuka, uye rinonyarara, rakafanana nechichena chezai chisina kuviriswa.
CervicalMucus.23: Yakakura, isingaoneki, kana kuti iripo zvishoma.
CervicalMucus.28: Zvinhu zvakawanda kupfuura zvaiitika mumazuva iwayo
CervicalMucus.30: Cherechedza chitarisiko chacho uye chimiro chacho uchishandisa pepa rekugezera kana kuti minwe yakachena, panguva imwe cheteyo yezuva, uye cherekedza zvaunoona.
CervicalMucus.33: Maitiro ekudzivirira pamuviri kana kuti mamwe marapirwo
CervicalMucus.35: Munhu wose ane chimiro chakasiyana, uye kuziva chako chaunofarira kunotora maitiro akawanda. Kuona kuchinja uku zuva nezuva, pamwe chete nezvimwe zviratidzo, kunokubatsira kuziva zviri nani hwindo rako rakaorera  ⁇  asi hazviutsivi zano rechiremba kana iwe  ⁇ unofunga.
CervicalMucus.37: Kuisa pamwe chete mucus womutsipa womukadzi nemibvunzo yako yebasa yemuviri kana kuti ovulation kunopa mufananidzo wakazara wezuva rako.
CervicalMucus.38: Mucus womumutsipa wemwana unochinja muviri panguva yose yemutambo uyu nemhaka yeestrogen uye progesterone.
CervicalMucus.39: Apo ovulation inoswedera pedyo, inova yakajeka, inotambanuka, uye inochinjika, yakafanana nechichena chezai risina kuumbwa.
CervicalMucus.40: Kuona kuchinja uku zuva nezuva, pamwe chete nezvimwe zviratidzo, kunokubatsira kuziva zvakanaka hwindo rako rinobereka.
CervicalMucus.41: Kuziva zvauri kuita kunoda kuti uzviite uye kuti uone zvinhu zvakawanda.
CervicalMucus.42: Nyaya ino haitsivi mazano evanhu panyaya dzeutano.

ChooseHormonalMethod.6: Mibvunzo yakarurama yokuzvibvunza kuti uwane nzira yokudzivirira nayo pamuviri yakakodzera upenyu hwako hwezuva nezuva, zvaunoda, uye zvirongwa zvako.

ChooseHormonalMethod.10: Mazano anogona kuita kuti zvinhu zvichinje
ChooseHormonalMethod.11: Ndiri kukurukura nezvenyaya iyi nemumwe nyanzvi
ChooseHormonalMethod.13: Hapana nzira imwe chete yakanaka yokudzivirira nayo pamuviri inowanzoshanda kune vose.

ChooseHormonalMethod.29: Kubudirira hakungoenderana nenzira yakasarudzwa chete, asiwo nokushandisa kwayo nenzira yakarurama uye yakarongeka.
ChooseHormonalMethod.31: Musiyano unokosha pakati pemarudzi acho ndewokuti unofanira kufunga kangani nezvokudzivirira pamuviri.

Chiremba, mubereki, kana kuti mumwewo nyanzvi yezvokurapa anogona kukubatsira kuona kana uchifanira kuenderera mberi, kugadzirisa kana kuchinja nzira yacho.
ChooseHormonalMethod.47: Zvirongwa zvako zvokubata pamuviri zvinogonawo kukanganisa zvaunosarudza. Kana uchida kudzivisa kubata pamuviri kwemakore akati wandei, nzira inogara kwenguva refu ingangodaro yakakodzera kufunga nezvayo. Kana uri kufunga nezvokuita pamuviri kare, dzimwe nzira dzingava dzakakodzera nguva yako.
ChooseHormonalMethod.49: Kutaura nezvezvirongwa zvako zvokubata pamuviri, kunyange kana zvichiri kure kana kuti zvisingazivikanwi, kunobatsira nyanzvi yezvokurapa kuti itungamirire hurukuro zviri nani.
ChooseHormonalMethod.50: Kuita musangano kunokubvumira kuongorora zvakanakira, zvinorambidzwa, uye zvinopesana nezvinogona kuitika nenzira imwe neimwe.
ChooseHormonalMethod.55: Chii chandinofanira kuita kana ndikakanganwa, kana zvikachinja, kana kuti kana ndichida kuzviita kuti zvisaitika?
ChooseHormonalMethod.56: Nzira iyi inokodzera zvirongwa zvangu zvokubata pamuviri here?
ChooseHormonalMethod.58: Muzvare kana kuti chiremba anogona kufunga nezvenhoroondo yako yeutano, marapirwo aunoitwa, zvaunofarira, uye mararamiro ako asati aronga nzira.
ChooseHormonalMethod.60: Sarudza nzira inokodzera upenyu hwako hwezuva nezuva.
ChooseHormonalMethod.62: Funga nezvezvirongwa zvako zvokubata pamuviri uye nguva yaunenge wava kuda.
ChooseHormonalMethod.63: Kumbira nyanzvi kuti ikupe zano kana usingazivi.
ChooseHormonalMethod.65: Nzira yakanakisisa haisi iyo inoita seyakanyanya nyore kana kuti inozivikanwa, asi ndiyo inokodzera mamiriro ako ezvinhu, zvaunoda, uye zvaunofarira, zvichitevera kukurukura kwakanaka nenyanzvi yezvokurapa.
ChooseHormonalMethod.66: Nyaya ino inoitira kuti vanhu vazive uye haitsivi mazano ekurapa.

ConceptionLifestyle.1: Mararamiro ako uye rwendo rwako rwokutanga
ConceptionLifestyle.6: Zvinhu zviri nyore zvinogona kutsigira rwendo rwako  ⁇  hapana kumanikidzwa.
ConceptionLifestyle.12: Dzimwe tsika dzakareruka dzoupenyu dzinogona kutsigira rwendo rwokufungidzira, kunyange zvazvo dzisingakwanisi kuvimbisa mugumisiro padziri.
ConceptionLifestyle.17: Kushushikana kusingaperi kunogona kukanganisa kuenzana kwemahormone uye, mune vamwe vakadzi, kugara uchidzokorora.
ConceptionLifestyle.19: Kuda kuita zvose zvakanaka kunogona kuva chinhu chinokonzera kushushikana: kutarisira tsika dzakanaka kazhinji kwakakwana, pasina kukwana.
ConceptionLifestyle.20: Kusvuta, uko kunogona kukanganisa kubereka kwevaviri
ConceptionLifestyle.22: Kudzidziswa kwakasimba, kwenguva refu, kunogona kuita kuti kubereka kuderere
ConceptionLifestyle.23: Kuwedzerwa kweshuga yakacheneswa, iyo inogona kukanganisa kuenzana kwehomoni
ConceptionLifestyle.25: Kazhinji kazhinji tsika dzakaringana, pasina kudarika kana kuti kuva nomufaro, ndidzo dzakanakisisa dzokutsigira zuva nezuva.

ConceptionStart.6: Mazano anokosha okuvamba rwendo rwako rwokuzvitora nechivimbo.
ConceptionStart.12: Nhanho yokutanga inobatsira zvikuru ndeyokuziva hwindo rako rinobereka uchishandisa nguva yako: nguva yenguva, zviratidzo zvomuviri, uye, kana uchida, zvigadziro zvokutevera zvakadai sokuongororwa kwe ovulation kana kuti tembiricha yemuviri.
ConceptionStart.13: Kuita zvepabonde nguva dzose, mazuva maviri kana matatu oga oga, kunofadza nguva yako yakaorera zvikuru pasina kudikanwa kworonga kwakanyanyisa.
ConceptionStart.14: Haufaniri kungogumira pazuva rokuberekwa kwemapfupa chete
ConceptionStart.15: Kuronga nguva nguva dzose kuri nyore kupfuura kuronga zvakarurama
ConceptionStart.17: Vazhinji vanorwara vanobata pamuviri mumwedzi 12 pashure pokurega kushandisa nzira dzokudzivirira pamuviri.
ConceptionStart.19: Kunze kwemwedzi 12 (kana mwedzi 6 pashure pemakore 35), zvinokurudzirwa kuti uone nyanzvi yezvokurapa kuti uongororwe, kunyange zvazvo izvi zvisingarevi kuti pane dambudziko.
ConceptionStart.21: Kuziva kutenderera kwako, kuchengeta nguva yako, uye kuramba uine mwoyo murefu ndiwo mavanga matatu okuvamba kworugare rwendo urwu.
